primaryText: John forgot that he stopped by the flower shop.
paperFeatures: John stopped by the flower shop
comment: Also (1) and (3). The cognition reading; (4a) is its presupposition.

primaryText: John forgot to stop by the flower shop.
paperFeatures: John was supposed to stop by the flower shop
If John stopped by the flowershop, it is because he remembered to do it.
comment: Also (2), which does not presuppose that John stopped. (5a) is the modalized presupposition, (5b) the necessity and sufficiency presupposition, which the paper leaves to future work.

primaryText: John forgot stopping by the flowershop but he did not have to stop by the flowershop.

comment: The embedded event must start before the forgetting.
